findings.fix: No visible white cast on application
findings.why: A flat 'no white cast' reads as an absolute for every skin tone. The page scopes it to application.

language_read: SPF, PA rating and the lab result are stated precisely and match the page, with the labelled value kept distinct from the test value. The only loose wording is the unscoped 'No white cast'.
tone_read: Calm, declarative and spec-led, with no fear, hype or emoji. It sounds like Minimalist.

rule_hit_review.why: The ad labels the product SPF 50 and reports 56.6 only as the independent in-vivo lab result, which matches page fact F16. It is a disclosed test result, not a different SPF claim.
